children: Macy's second-quarter earnings received a boost from $98 million in tariff refunds under the International Emergency Economic Powers Act. The net tariff refund benefit added $0.23 to adjusted diluted EPS, lifting the figure to $0.63 for the period ending Aug. 1. Excluding the tariff benefit, adjusted EPS rose 14% year-over-year. Macy's has collected $116 million in total expected refunds and plans to reinvest $96 million into customer initiatives and its turnaround strategy during 2026. Only about $20 million, or roughly $0.05 per share, flows directly to full-year earnings
